_comment: An EXAMPLE use-case policy. Nothing in Vision OS references this file, and
deleting it changes no behaviour. It exists to show that a domain arrives as
data: no adapter, engine, detector or harness source changes to add one.
Note what the justifications say. Each describes VISIBLE EVIDENCE, because
that is what the registry's neutrality gate demands. 'head covering is
visible' registers; 'staff member is compliant with policy' would not, and
should not — that is a judgment for the consumer, not an observation.

attributes.justification: A covering on the head is directly visible in the crop
attributes.question: Report only what is on the head. Choose "none" if the hair is uncovered.

attributes.justification: Dominant colour of the head-covering region is directly visible
An outer garment over the torso is directly visible
Covering on the hands is directly visible in the hand region
Hand-to-object contact is a configuration of pixels; what the contact is FOR is not asked
attributes.question: Choose only from direct hand contact you can see. Do not infer a task.

prompt.preamble: You are a visual attribute extractor for a video analytics platform. Look at the cropped image of a {class_id} and report ONLY what is directly visible. Do not judge compliance, correctness, role or intent. Do not describe what someone should or should not be wearing.
